work.title: Experience & Projects
work.description: I've been building full-stack products and platforms, from AI-driven tools to production systems, as a solo developer or as part of a larger engineering team.

experience.description: Designed scalable frontend architecture with Vue and TypeScript across 3 products while developing full-stack AI features using Express and MySQL, including real-time chat, fact-checking systems, standardized REST APIs, and automated API generation that reduced development turnaround by 40%.

Developed and maintained full-stack web applications across multiple client projects using Vue.js, Laravel, CodeIgniter, and MySQL. Applied component-based frontend architecture with Element Plus while implementing backend features, database integrations, and production enhancements for the LSP Exam System, Cost Control App, and Village Website. Collaborated directly with clients to gather requirements, present progress, and ensure solutions aligned with business needs.

paragraphs: I build scalable software that delivers reliable user experiences. Using Vue, React, Next.js, Express, MySQL, Docker, and modern AI tooling, I develop applications that remain fast, maintainable, and resilient across real-time communication, complex integrations, and production-scale systems.

Whether it's an AI chat platform, a fact-checking system, a geospatial visualization dashboard, or a full-stack business application, I design and engineer end-to-end solutions with a strong focus on performance, API consistency, scalability, and developer experience.

items.question: What projects do you work on?
items.answer: Mostly AI-driven web products and full-stack platforms — interactive AI chat interfaces, geospatial and statistical data visualization, semantic search, and fact-checking tools, alongside production SaaS work like Chaplin, Blayer, and Casetudy.

items.question: Do you work remotely or on-site?
items.answer: I'm based in Bandung, Jawa Barat, and work remotely with teams and clients across time zones — I've done this for 3 years at Kazee Digital Indonesia and Surya Microsystems, collaborating async with cross-functional teams.

items.question: What's your tech stack and tooling?
items.answer: Vue.js, Nuxt, Next.js, React, and TypeScript on the frontend; Node.js, Express, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Docker on the backend; plus SSE/WebSockets for real-time streaming and Claude Code, DeepSeek, and prompt engineering for AI-driven workflows.

items.question: Can I see more of your work?
items.answer: Yes — check the Experience & Projects section above for case studies like Chaplin, Blayer, Kazee Smartboard, and the LSP Exam System, or reach out directly for a deeper walkthrough.

items.question: How can I start a new project?
items.answer: Send me an email or a message on WhatsApp with a short brief of what you're building — I'll get back to you to discuss requirements, scope, and timeline in more detail.

footer.heading: It's time to build your next web project. Let's work together and deliver success.

testimonials.quote: I had a great experience working with Dzikri. He consistently delivered clean, high-quality work and demonstrated strong technical skills. Communication was always clear and professional, making collaboration smooth and efficient. Dzikri is reliable, easy to work with, and always committed to delivering the best results. I highly recommend him for any team or project.

He has a strong sense of curiosity and is always eager to learn and grow. His frontend skills are excellent, and he's also a capable full-stack engineer. He's easy to work with, an effective team player, and even in high-pressure situations, he helps keep discussions calm and productive. On top of that, he has a strong sense of ownership—once he takes responsibility for something, he makes sure it's delivered well.

I'm confident he'll continue to grow and become an even stronger, well-rounded engineer in the future.
